scope: iPhone normal/light and Accessibility XXXL/dark Today task reachability, on-demand Search, submitted-query recents, explicit Close, portrait-query/landscape continuity; landscape capture persistence regressions.
changes: TaskScreen owns one on-demand native text-field presentation across orientations, with explicit 44-point Close that clears the filter and dismisses keyboard. Search is a toolbar action; Command-F is declared.
Search submission remembers the query and dismisses keyboard; recent-query menu preserves reuse/clear functionality.
Dated filtered results scroll to their first match when the query changes, avoiding the prior stale offset behind Search. No query text is stored in task records.
No persistence/sync contract or Mac production code changes. The Mac retains its independently owned Finder search.
build: ios-landscape-today-build-v15.log: TEST BUILD SUCCEEDED; strict app/widget/runner team and Simulator identities verified in landscape-today/signing.json.

native.consoleDiagnostics: Apple AX duplicate-class and debugger-version diagnostics retained; no blanket clean-console claim.

verified: Actual landscape window, complete task-details targets in visible viewport above tabs, exact editor title/Cancel for both Today fixture tasks, relaunch and reachability.
Search query submission leaves no keyboard, yields exact matching task and excludes unrelated task; complete matching target fits below Search and above tabs.
Explicit Close removes field and restores original tasks; recent submitted query can be selected and closed again.
Query typed in portrait remains visible with exact value after rotation to landscape; Close restores unfiltered list.
Calendar capture date Today→Tomorrow→Today, Inbox selection, Save and persisted task existence after relaunch without reseeding.
limits: Capture persistence case checks record existence, not complete saved-row visibility. Its retained largest screenshot remains partly below tabs; general long-task list readability is not accepted.
Tests accept the named two fixture task targets and one query on iPhone iOS 26.5, not all task scopes/boards, iPad, older runtimes or empty search results.
Command-F is declared/build verified; hardware-keyboard and spoken VoiceOver are not accepted.
Four prior unfiltered clipping findings, keyboard-visible composer presentation, other widget/provider/delivery/distribution gates remain open.
intermediateEvidence: v1 normal passes, largest task containment fails; v2 largest still fails after drag correction. Original baseline has 100-point Search and 144-point effective viewport.

v3 native minimized Search candidate passes task routes. v4 passes capture cases but Search test used Cancel rather than observed Close; v5–v8 retain native Close failures. These are abandoned candidate limitations, not claims about every OS/device.
v10 explicit Close restores tasks and capture passes, but recent submission callback fails; corrected with direct callback and keyboard dismissal. v12 both scoped Search cases pass.

v13 conditional native-search portrait field disappears after rotation; replaced by a single app-owned presentation across orientations. v14 four cases pass, but screenshot review exposes partial largest query result not covered by earlier presence assertion.
v15 scrolls to first dated match and requires full result containment below field; all four final cases pass.
